prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Try out controlling, hiding, and summoning your pet right on your desktop before finishing setup.", "Start Quick Calibration", "Desktop Pet Control Sandbox", "Click to toggle desktop visibility, try shortcut commands, and test companion response.", "Desktop Overlay Test", "Test Hide/Show Shortcut"]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select the path that matches how you want to interact with your desktop companion.", "Begin Path", "Select Journey Path"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Review essential desktop controls and shortcuts before launching to your desktop screen.", "View Control Guide", "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Press Option/Alt + P to summon or hide your pet anytime. Drag to reposition on desktop.", "Desktop Control Essentials", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
3: []
4: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Overlay", "Checking graphics renderer, desktop display bounds, and animating pet assets.", "Ensuring desktop overlay permissions and graphics status are fully ready..."]
5: ["Sign In to Restore & Sync Your Desktop Pets", "Logging into your account securely links all previous adoption records and custom pets so nothing is ever lost.", "Existing pets and custom graphics will automatically sync upon authentication."]
6: ["Choose Your Quick Onboarding Path (2 Min)", "Select how you'd like to build your desktop pet today. You can customize traits and desktop behavior anytime later.", "Takes less than 2 minutes. All paths include desktop overlay support."]
7: ["Upload Companion Photos", "Provide clear photos for best companion rendering results on your desktop screen.", "Upload Photo Asset", "Photo Rendering Quality Check"]
8: ["Desktop overlay is rendering in the background. If using multiple monitors, your pet will appear on your primary screen."]
9: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Complete setup now to instantly unlock the Exclusive Desktop Pet Starter Pack on your screen.", "Bonus Desktop Pack Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Promises bonus items and creates urgency to complete setup
